output.notes: Described the standard-parameterization (SP) Cerebras-GPT models, which are the released family (111M-13B); muP variants (embedding multiplier 10, 1/d_head attention scale, logits /m_width) are a secondary set and not described. n_heads not stated directly; it is derivable as d_model/d_head (the FLOPs code uses num_heads = d_model // key_size), but it is left not_stated. Pre-LN placement is inherited via the explicit 'standard GPT-2 transformer block' sentence. GeLU is named, but the paper does not say whether it is the exact or tanh form. Tied embeddings and the bias-free output head are inferred from the parameter-count formula, which has no separate output-layer term. Block attribute values (head_dim 64, FFN 3072, scale 0.125 = 1/sqrt(64)) are for the primary 111M config. Norm eps is not stated.
